get.summary: Return a list of all Submittals.
get.description: Return a list of all Submittals.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[anticipated_delivery_date]
parameters.description: Array of dates (date range). Returns item(s) with their anticipated delivery date within the specified dates. A single date is also accepted. style: form

parameters.name: filters[ball_in_court_id]
parameters.description: User ID. Return item(s) where the specified User ID is the Ball in Court.

parameters.name: filters[ball_in_court_company_id]
parameters.description: Company ID. Return item(s) where the specified Company ID is the Ball in Court.

parameters.name: filters[closed_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) that are due within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[query]
parameters.description: Return item(s) containing search query

parameters.name: filters[received_from_id]
parameters.description: Received From ID

parameters.name: filters[responsible_contractor_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Responsible Contractor ID.

parameters.name: filters[specification_section_id]
parameters.description: Array of Specification Section IDs. A single Specification Section ID is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[approver_id]
parameters.description: Array of User IDs. Return item(s) where the specified User IDs are in the approver list. A single integer is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[current_revision]
parameters.description: Default false. If true, only current revisions are shown. If false, all submittals are shown, regardless of whether or not it is the current revision.

parameters.name: filters[division]
parameters.description: Array of Divisions to filter on. A Division is the first two digits from the Specification Section Number. A single Division is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Array of Location IDs. A single Location ID is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[submittal_manager_id]
parameters.description: Array of Submittal Manager IDs. A single Submittal Manager ID is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[submittal_package_id]
parameters.description: Array of Submittal Package IDs. Returns item(s) associated with the specified Submittal Package IDs. A single integer value is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[response_id]
parameters.description: Array of Response IDs. A single Response ID is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[sent_date]
parameters.description: Array of dates (date range). Returns item(s) where an approver's sent date falls within the specified dates. A single date is also accepted. Use "NULL" to filter for submittals with no sent date. style: form

parameters.name: filters[workflow_step]
parameters.description: Array of workflow step numbers. Returns submittal(s) currently on one of the given steps. A single step number is also accepted. Use "NULL" to filter for submittals with no workflow step.

parameters.name: filters[status_id]
parameters.description: Array of Status IDs. A single Status ID is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[type]
parameters.description: Array of Submittal Types. A single Submittal Type is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[unpackaged]
parameters.description: Parseable to boolean value, filters out unpackaged Submittals.

parameters.name: filters[number]
parameters.description: Array of Numbers. A single Number is also accepted.

parameters.name: filters[has_operation_errors]
parameters.description: Parseable to boolean value, filters Submittals based on whether they have operation errors from bulk operations.

parameters.name: filters[operation_errors_by_operation_id]
parameters.description: Filters Submittals that have operation errors associated with specific operation ID(s). Accepts single or multiple operation IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Structure to sort submittal rows

parameters.name: show_attachments
parameters.description: Determine the AttachmentVisible tag value(depend on configurable field set).

parameters.name: minimal_submittal_package
parameters.description: When `true`, each submittal's `submittal_package` in the response includes only `id`, `number`, `title`, and `created_by` for smaller payloads and faster responses. Omit or set to `false` for the full package object.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Dynamic configured custom-field filters. Use a `custom_field_{definition_id}` key, for example `filters[custom_field_123]=true` or `filters[custom_field_456][]=789`. Values may be strings or arrays of strings. Use `NULL` to match submittals without a value where supported.

actual_delivery_date.description:
The Actual Delivery Date of the Submittal
*This field can only be set if the project has submittal delivery information enabled

bic_due_date.description: The Ball-in-Court Due Date of the Submittal. For DSP projects, this comes from the submittal plan. For non-DSP projects with workflows, this is calculated from current step approvers.

confirmed_delivery_date.description:
The Confirmed Delivery Date of the Submittal
*This field can only be set if the project has submittal delivery information enabled

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the submittal was closed.

cost_code_id.description:
The ID of the Cost Code of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

current_step_approvers.description: List of approvers for the current workflow step. For completed workflows, this shows approvers from the final step. Empty for submittals without workflows.

response_required.description: Whether a response is required from this approver

user.description: The user information for the approver

current_step_returned_date.description: The latest returned date from current step approvers who have answered. For completed workflows, this shows the date from the final step.

current_step_sent_date.description: The earliest sent date to current step approvers. For completed workflows, this shows the date from the final step.

custom_textarea_1.description: *This field can only be set by admins

custom_textfield_1.description: *This field can only be set by admins

design_team_review_time.description:
The Design Team Review Time of the Submittal (in days)
*This field can only be set if the project has schedule calculations enabled

distribution_member_ids.description: The IDs of the Distribution Members of the Submittal

due_date.description:
The Due Date of the Submittal
*This field is not available to be set if sequential approvers is enabled

due_date_days.description: The number of calendar days between today (in the project's local timezone) and the submittal's due date. Negative values indicate the due date has passed. Returns null when no due date is set. For DSP-enabled projects this value is sourced from the submittal plan; for non-DSP projects it is derived from the persisted due_date field.

has_responded_approver.description: Whether the Submittal has at least one approver that has responded, i.e. at least one approver has a returned date set.

internal_review_time.description:
The Internal Review Time of the Submtital (in days)
*This field can only be set if the project has schedule calculations enabled

issue_date.description:
The Issue Date of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

lead_time.description:
The Lead Time of the Submittal (in days)
*This field can only be set by admins or if the project has schedule calculations enabled

private.description: Whether the Submittal is Private or not

received_date.description:
The Received Date of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

received_from_id.description: The Received From of the Submittal

response_considered.description: The response category of the latest completed workflow response (e.g. 'approved', 'void'). Null when no approver has responded.

required_on_site_date.description:
The Required On Site Date of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins or if the project has schedule calculations enabled

responsible_contractor_id.description: The Responsible Contractor of the Submittal

scheduled_task_key.description:
The key of the Scheduled Task of the Submittal. Note that use of this parameter is deprecated. Please use `scheduled_task_id` instead.
*This field can only be set if the project has submittal delivery information enabled and the user has permissions to view the calendar tool

scheduled_task_id.description:
The ID of the Scheduled Task of the Submittal
*This field can only be set if the project has submittal delivery information enabled and the user has permissions to view the calendar tool

specification_section_id.description: The ID of the Specification Section of the Submittal

status_id.description:
The ID of the Submittal Status of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

sub_job_id.description: The ID of the Sub Job of the Submittal

submit_by.description:
The Submit By Date of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

submittal_manager_id.description:
The ID of the Submittal Manager of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

submittal_package_id.description:
The ID of the Submittal Package of the Submittal
*This field can only be set by admins

type.description: The Submittal Type of the Submittal

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the submittal was last updated.

workflow_approval_status_key.description: The approval state of the Submittal workflow. 'rejected' when the latest completed response is rejected, revise and resubmit, or void; 'approved' when the workflow is complete; 'pending' when at least one approver has responded; and 'not_started' otherwise.

workflow_step.description: Current workflow step information. Shows step progress and optional days late indicator. Null for submittals without workflows.

total_steps.description: The total number of steps in the workflow

days_late.description: Number of days the current step is late (only included if positive). Based on the earliest due date of pending approvers in the current step.

can_update_submit_by.description: Whether the current user can update this submittal's submit by date inline.

can_update_required_on_site_date.description: Whether the current user can update this submittal's required on site date inline.

can_update_actual_delivery_date.description: Whether the current user can update this submittal's actual delivery date inline.

can_update_confirmed_delivery_date.description: Whether the current user can update this submittal's confirmed delivery date inline.

can_update_lead_time.description: Whether the current user can update this submittal's lead time inline. False for for-record-only submittals under Dynamic Submittal Plan.

can_update_workflow_dates.description: Whether the current user can update workflow sent and returned dates inline.

can_view_buffer_time_and_variance.description: Whether the current user can view buffer time and variance for this submittal.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/submittals?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Banticipated_delivery_date%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bball_in_court_id%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bball_in_court_company_id%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bclosed_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bquery%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Breceived_from_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bresponsible_contractor_id%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bspecification_section_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bapprover_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcurrent_revision%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bdivision%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Blocation_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bsubmittal_manager_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bsubmittal_package_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bresponse_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bsent_date%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bworkflow_step%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bstatus_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Btype%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bunpackaged%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bnumber%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bhas_operation_errors%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Boperation_errors_by_operation_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE&show_attachments=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&minimal_submittal_package=true&filters=SOME_OBJECT_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-code-samples.title: C#

x-changelog.summary: Add email_sent_at to submittal approvers in the V2 submittals list
x-changelog.description: Returns email_sent_at on each submittal approver, the datetime when the notification email was dispatched to the approver, expressed in the project's timezone. Null for historical records or when no email was sent; sent_date may be present while email_sent_at is null when the approver was sent the submittal without an email notification.

x-changelog.summary: Return the stored status category on the V2 submittals list
x-changelog.description: status.status on each submittal in the list is the stored category (Open, Closed, or Draft) again. status.name remains the localized label. The company submittal log statuses endpoint still localizes its status field.

x-changelog.summary: Add updated_at to the V2 submittals list
x-changelog.description: Returns updated_at, the timestamp when the submittal was last updated, on each submittal in the list.

x-changelog.summary: Added non-final-due-date inline permissions to the List Submittals endpoint
x-changelog.description: Adds per-row `permissions.can_update_required_on_site_date`, `permissions.can_update_actual_delivery_date`, `permissions.can_update_confirmed_delivery_date`, and `permissions.can_update_lead_time`, matching the shape already used by `permissions.can_update_submit_by`. All four are false for for-record-only submittals under Dynamic Submittal Plan, since only Final Due Date exists on such a submittal.

x-changelog.summary: Derive workflow_approval_status_key rejected from the latest completed response
x-changelog.description: `workflow_approval_status_key` now returns `rejected` when the latest completed workflow response is rejected, revise and resubmit, or void, including when the reject-workflow project setting is off. Completed Void / Revise and Resubmit workflows no longer serialize as `approved`.

x-changelog.summary: Added buffer time display permission to V2 submittals list
x-changelog.description: Adds `permissions.can_view_buffer_time_and_variance` to the V2 submittals list response so clients can gate buffer time and variance from backend-owned item permissions.

x-changelog.summary: Add custom field filtering to the submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Adds support for filtering the submittals list with dynamic `filters[custom_field_{definition_id}]` parameters. Supported configured custom fields include booleans, numbers, datetimes, references, and multi-value references. Filters also support "NULL" where applicable.

x-changelog.summary: Add workflow approval status fields to the V2 submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Added `workflow_approval_status_key` (rejected, approved, pending, or not_started) and `response_considered` (the response category of the latest completed workflow response, null when no approver has responded) to the submittals list api.

x-changelog.summary: Add due_date_days and workflow_step_days_late sort options to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Add two new sort options to the submittals list API. `due_date_days` sorts by the signed number of days between the submittal's due date and today (overdue submittals sort as negative, upcoming ones as positive), grouping non-closed submittals first, then closed, then those without a due date. `workflow_step_days_late` sorts by how many days the current workflow step is past due, placing submittals that are not late at the bottom. Prefix the sort value with a minus for descending order (e.g. sort=-due_date_days).

x-changelog.summary: Add workflow_step filter to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Add a workflow_step filter to the submittals list API to narrow submittals to the workflow step they are currently on. Accepts an array of step numbers (a single step number is also accepted) and "NULL" to filter for submittals with no workflow step.

x-changelog.summary: Added row action permissions to List Submittals endpoint
x-changelog.description: Adds per-row `permissions.can_edit` to support backend-owned edit action visibility in list clients.

x-changelog.summary: Added inline edit permissions to List Submittals endpoint
x-changelog.description: Adds per-row `permissions` flags for inline-editable list fields.

x-changelog.summary: Introduce GET Submittals Endpoint
x-changelog.description: Return a list of all Submittals from a specified Project.

x-changelog.summary: Added workflow step information fields to Submittals listing
x-changelog.description: Added new fields to display current workflow step information: `workflow_step` (with current step, total steps, and optional days late), `current_step_approvers` (approvers for current step only), `current_step_sent_date`, `current_step_returned_date`, and unified `bic_due_date` for both DSP and non-DSP projects. Enhanced approver objects with `response_required` and `user` fields.

x-changelog.summary: Add anticipated_delivery_date date filter and sort to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Add anticipated delivery date filter and sort to submittals list API. This filter and sort feature is currently in beta and may not function as expected in all cases.

x-changelog.summary: Submittal status IDs are changed to be unique per company
x-changelog.description: The `filters[status_id]` parameter now uses different status IDs than before. Status IDs are unique per company. To get the correct status IDs for your company, use the GET /rest/v1.0/companies/{company_id}/submittal_statuses endpoint.

x-changelog.summary: Add closed_at to Submittals v2 list response
x-changelog.description: Adds `closed_at` (timestamp when the submittal was closed) to the Submittals v2 list response body.

x-changelog.summary: V2 List Submittals no longer includes is_rejected, updated_at, open_date, attachments, and related fields
x-changelog.description:
The following attributes have been removed from the List Submittals response (GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/submittals) to improve performance. This is a breaking change for consumers that rely on these fields in the list response. Use the Show Submittal endpoint (GET .../submittals/{id}) for full details including these attributes.
Removed attributes: `is_rejected`, `rejected_submittal_log_approver_id`, `source_submittal_log_id`, `updated_at`, `open_date`, `attachments` (array). The `attachments_count` attribute is unchanged and remains in the list response.

x-changelog.summary: Add schedule_v2_activity_id and sent_date filters to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Add filters to submittals list API: schedule_v2_activity_id (filter by linked Schedule V2 activities via Related Items) and sent_date (filter by approver sent date).

x-changelog.summary: Add six new sort options to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Add sort capability for submittal_manager (by manager name), attachments_count, planned_return_date, planned_internal_review_completed_date, planned_submit_by_date, and sent_date (by approver sent date). Prefix sort value with minus for descending (e.g. sort=-submittal_manager).

x-changelog.summary: Add minimal_submittal_package query parameter to List Submittals v2
x-changelog.description: The List Submittals endpoint accepts an optional query parameter `minimal_submittal_package`. When set to `true`, each submittal's `submittal_package` in the response includes only `id`, `number`, `title`, and `created_by`, reducing payload size for list views. Omit the parameter or set it to `false` for the full `submittal_package` object.

x-changelog.summary: Add has_workflow to v2 list response; approvers opt-out via drop_approvers
x-changelog.description: Adds a `has_workflow` boolean to the v2 Submittals list response, true when the submittal has any approvers. Clients that pass `drop_approvers=true` opt in to a slimmer payload where the `approvers` array is omitted (subject to server-side enablement). Clients that do not pass the parameter continue to receive `approvers` unchanged. Full approver details remain available on the Show endpoint (GET /companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/submittals/{id}).

x-changelog.summary: Reintroduce is reject field on the V2 submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Added the is rejected field to the submittals list api

x-changelog.summary: Introduce associated attachments count on the V2 submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Added a new associated attachments count field to the submittals list api that returns both the count of  attachments on the submittal as well as any attachments added by an approver.

x-changelog.summary: Add associated attachments filter on the V2 submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Added a new associated attachments count field to the submittals list api that filters on both the count of  attachments on the submittal as well as any attachments added by an approver.

x-changelog.summary: Added estimated workflow completion date to the Submittal response
x-changelog.description: Added an estimated_workflow_completion_date field to the submittal plan data in the Submittal response — the projected date the submittal's workflow completes. It surfaces on the submittal show, list, and bulk-shared-review responses.

x-changelog.summary: Add custom field sorting to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Bring custom fields to parity with standard fields when sorting the submittals list. Sorting by a custom field orders submittals by that field's value and consistently places submittals with no value at the bottom of the list.

x-changelog.summary: Add has_responded_approver to the V2 submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Added a new `has_responded_approver` boolean field to the submittals list api. It is true when the submittal has at least one approver with a returned date, indicating an approver has responded.

x-changelog.summary: Add null_aware_location_id_with_sublocations filter to submittals list API
x-changelog.description: Add a `null_aware_location_id_with_sublocations` filter to the submittals list API. Accepts an array of location ids and expands each to include all of its sublocations. Unlike `location_id_with_sublocations`, it also accepts "NULL" to filter for submittals with no location.

x-changelog.summary: Add Due Date Days field to the submittals List API
x-changelog.description: Added a new field that calculates the difference between the due date and the today's date , this field already existed for DSP Projects now it is rendered for the default view as well.
